capabilities: Roll unfinished todos from the previous journal note into a newly created note
Find the previous note by scanning journal-date frontmatter via the metadata cache
Insert todos under a heading matching a configurable regex, with bottom/top/skip fallback
Optionally delete rolled todos from the previous note and carry nested child lines
Run rollover manually via a command on the active note
disambiguation: Works only with notes created by the Journals plugin; it does not roll todos between ordinary Daily Notes vaults.
extras: The 'delete todos from the previous note' option is destructive and off by default; the README documents all defaults in a settings table.
intentEvidence: It is a spiritual successor to Rollover Daily Todos, rewritten so it no longer depends on the core Daily Notes
motivation: The author built it because the original Rollover Daily Todos cannot reconstruct Journals' note paths, so rollover silently bails out; keying off journal-date frontmatter sidesteps that.
problem: Todo rollover plugins that reconstruct daily-note paths from a static folder and date format silently fail with the Journals plugin's nested, date-templated folders.

relations.evidence: It is a spiritual successor to Rollover Daily Todos
built to work with the Journals plugin

summary: Task rollover plugin that moves unfinished todos from the previous Journals note into a newly created one, locating notes via journal-date frontmatter.
